title: Face and five-sided pyramid at Cydonia Mensa

tellings.quote: we were looking at Cydonia Mensa, which is a site where there's the face and then there's a nearby like 5 mi away there's a five-sided pyramid that NASA never shows that picture of the face beside the pyramid together in any of their public photos because it becomes obvious.

plain: On Mars, at a site called Cydonia Mensa, there is a formation that looks like a face, and about five miles away there is a five-sided pyramid. The researcher John Brandenburg tells Michels this, talking about images of the area going back to 1976. He says NASA has never shown the face and the pyramid together in any of its public photos, "because it becomes obvious", meaning that seen side by side they would look built, which is why the claim matters to him.
